versions.changelog:
Grocery Flow Architect v1.0.0

- Initial release: Optimize grocery trips by mapping your personal store walk and reordering shopping lists to match.
- One-time zone mapping per store creates a custom aisle-by-aisle guide for all future trips.
- Automatically assigns items to zones (with a built-in matcher/persistent learning for unknown items).
- Staples radar flags commonly forgotten items based on your usage cadence.
- Multi-store trips are supported, with merged ordered lists and suggested store sequence for efficient errands.
- All store data and customizations saved locally for privacy and continuous improvement.
